name: Agreement Parties and Effectiveness
text: THISFARMOUTAGREEMENTDATED April 12 ,1996, (hereinafterreferred to as Agreement), is entered into by and between Equitable Resources Energy Company, a West Virginia Corporation, with offices at Two Executive Park Place, 1989 East Stone Drive, P. 0. Box 1983, Kingsport, Tennessee 37662-1983, (hereinafter called "Farmor") and the above named "Farmee", and shall be effective as hereinafter provided.

name: Initial Location Fee
text: WHEREAS, Farmee agrees, concurrent with its execution of this Farmout Agreement, to pay Farmor, at Farmor's address herein, an initial location fee in the amount of Two Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00).

name: Farmout Grant and Reservation
text: WHEREAS, subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein,Farmor agrees that Farmee may acquire an interest in the Farmout Lands described in Exhibit "A" and Exhibit "B" attached hereto and made a part hereof; provided, however, that Farmor expressly excepts and reserves unto itself all rights associated with those portions of Fee Tracts 5-1 162 and 5- 1 163 lying within a 2000' radius circle surrounding Well KF-1053, which well is identified on the Exhibit "B" attached hereto.

name: 1. Exhibits
text: 1. EXHIBITS The following exhibits are attached hereto and shall be considered part of this Farmout Agreement: Exhibit "A" - Schedule describing the oil and gas lands subject hereto. Exhibit "B" - Plat of Farmout Lands. Exhibit "B-1 "- Plat of Right of First Refusal acreage. Exhibit "C" - Geological Requirement Letter. Exhibit "D" - Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights.

name: 2(A). Completed Well
text: 2. DEFINITIONS (A) A "completed well " is a well which has been fully equipped for the taking of production through and including the tanks for an oil well and through and I 1. ,A Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 3 of 18 - Page ID#: 28 : � � • including the christmas tree for a gas well, or plugged and abandoned, if a dry hole.

name: 2(B). Drilling Unit
text: (B) The term "drilling unit " means the area within the surface boundaries established or prescribed by field rules or order of the applicable regulatory authority, e.g. the spacing unit, unit for production, or proration unit.

name: 2(C). Earning Well
text: (C) The term " earning well " means any well drilled under the terms and conditions of this Agreement by which Farmee is entitled to receive an Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights.

name: 2(D). Operating Rights Earned
text: (D) "Operating Rights Earned" are those rights earned, including the right to operate, maintain and produce oil and/or gas from any well drilled hereunder, including the right to produce oil and/or gas from that portion and only that portion of the Farmout Lands lying in an Eighty (80) acre circle centered around each gas well drilled which is capable of producing in paying quantities, and the right to produce oil and/or gas from that portion and only that portion of the Farmout lands lying within a Forty (40) acre circle centered around each oil well drilled which is capable of producing in paying quantities. No operating rights may be earned hereunder in or to those portions of Fee Tracts 5-1 162 and 5- 1163 lying within a 2000' radius circle centered around Well KF-1053.

name: 2(E). Lease Burdens
text: (E) The term " lease burdens " means any royalty, overriding royalty, production payment, and other similar burdens on production.

name: 2(F). Contract Depth
text: (F) " Contract Depth " shall be from the surface of the earth down to a depth of four thousand feet (4,000').

name: 2(G). Test Well
text: (G) The term " test well " means the initial well drilled pursuant to the terms and conditions contained herein.

name: 2(H). Shut-In Well
text: (H) The term " shut-in well " means any well shut-in that has previously produced and is still capable of producing in commercial quantities.

name: 2(I). Subseauent Well
text: (I) The term " subseauent well " means any well drilled after the drilling and completion of the initial test well.

name: 2(J). Unearned Farmout Land
text: (J) "Unearned Farmout Land" shall mean those lands covered by this Farmout Agreement on which Operating Rights have not been earned by Farmee pursuant to the terms and conditions hereunder.

name: 2(K). Payout
text: (K) "Payout" shall be defined as when the gross proceeds attributable to the sale or production from a well equals the cost of drilling, completing and equipping said well.

name: 3(A). Test Well Obligation
text: 3. FARMOUT WELL/WELLS (A) Farmee shall drill a well, hereinafter called the "test well" strictly in accordance with the following well specifications:

name: 3(A)(1). Test Well Location
text: (1) Location: Farmee's choice on Farmout Land or on a drilling unit that includes all or a portion of Farmout Lands.

name: 3(A)(2). Test Well Spudding Deadline
text: (2) Spudding Deadline: On or before August 31, 1996, Farmee must commence the actual drilling of the test well at the location specified above.

name: 3(A)(3). Test Well Completion/Plugging Deadline
text: (3) Completion/Plugging Deadline: Within forty-five (45) days after reaching total depth in the test well.

name: 3(B). Subsequent-Well Option
text: (B) Provided the "test well" herein is completed as a well capable of production in paying quantities, or plugged and abandoned, Farmee shall have the option to further develop and/or further explore the Farmout Lands by the drilling of "Subsequent Wells" strictly in accordance with the following "Subsequent Wells" specifications:

name: 3(B)(1). Subsequent-Well Location
text: (1) Location: Farmee's choice on Unearned Farmout Land or on a drilling unit that includes all or a portion of Unearned Farmout Lands.

name: 3(B)(2). Subsequent-Well Location Fee
text: (2) Location Fee: Prior to the commencement of each Subsequent Well on Farmout Lands or on a drilling unit containing a portion of Farmout Lands, Farmee will promptly pay Farmor a location fee of Two Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00).

name: 3(B)(3). Subsequent-Well Spudding Deadline
text: (3) Spudding Deadline: On or before December 31, 1996, Farmee must commence the actual drilling of two (2) Subsequent Wells, (at the locations specified above) and, at Farmee's further option, it shall continuously develop the Farmout Lands by commencing the actual drilling of a minimum of two (2) Subsequent Wells per calendar year on the Farmout Lands or lands pooled therewith, beginning January 1, 1997, and thereafter until the Farmout Lands subject hereto are fully 3 Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 5 of 18 - Page ID#: 30 • I developed in accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein.

name: 3(B)(4). Subsequent-Well Completion/Plugging Deadline
text: (4) Completion/Plugging Deadline: Within forty-five (45) days of reaching total depth in each well.

name: 3(C). Substitute Well
text: (C) Substitute Well: In the event any well provided for herein is lost for any reason prior to being drilled to Contract Depth or Farmee has encountered, during the drilling of any well, mechanical difficulty or formation or condition which would render further drilling impractical or impossible, Farmee may plug and abandon such well and thereafter may continue its rights hereunder by commencing a substitute well for any such well within thirty (30) days from the date the well was lost or abandoned. Any substitute well drilled hereunder shall be drilled subject to the same terms and conditions and to the same depth as provided for the well so lost and abandoned.

name: 3(D)(1). Assignment of Operating Rights
text: (D) Assignment of Operating Rights - Produce to Earn: Upon receipt of Farmee's written request and within sixty (60) days after Farmor is satisfied that Farmee has complied with all its obligations (including but not limited to all geologic requirements as set out in Exhibit "C") under this Agreement with regard to the completion of a farmout well as a well capable of production in paying quantities, Farmor shall deliver to Farmee: (1) An Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights (in the form as set out in Exhibit "D") of Farmor's interest in Operating Rights Earned. Operating Rights Earned shall be defined for the test well and any subsequent wells drilled hereunder in accordance with Section 2(D) herein.

name: 3(D)(2). Assignment Request Deadline
text: (2) If the request for Assignment has not been received by the Farmor within sixty ( 60) days after a well has been completed as a well capable of production in paying quantities, Farmee forfeits its right to receive the Assignment and shall promptly proceed to plug and abandon any well situated upon the Farmout Lands in which Farmee has failed to comply with the time frame contained herein.

name: 3(E). Depths Earned
text: (E) Depths Earned: The Operating Rights earned shall be from the surface of the earth down to 100' below the total depth drilled, not to exceed a depth of four thousand feet (4,000').

name: 3(F). Default by Farmee
text: (F) Default By Farmee: Time being of the essence under this Agreement, in the event Farmee fails to commence, continue drilling or complete any well in accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein, this Agreement shall terminate except as to those Operating Rights earned in accordance with the terms and conditions as contained herein. If Farmee defaults, other than above, in the timely and proper performance of any obligations hereunder, Farmor shall have the right to terminate this Agreement by giving Farmee thirty ( 30) days written notice to cure such default. In the event such default is not cured by Farmee within thirty days of receipt of notice by Farmee, this Farmout Agreement shall terminate except as to those Operating Rights Earned in accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein and Farmee shall have no further rights hereunder, but in no event shall Farmee be relieved of the obligation to plug and abandon any wells drilled hereunder. Also, if Farmee defaults, in addition to any other available legal or equitable remedies, Farmor may elect to take over operation of (subject to the terms of Section 6 below) any well, inclusive of but not limited to any well which is scheduled to be plugged and abandoned by the Farmee, which has not yet satisfied the earning requirements of this Agreement. This Farmout shall remain in full force and effect as to those Operating Rights Earned in accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein.

name: Section 4(A) — Reserved Overriding Royalty Interest
text: 4. RESERVED OVERRIDING ROYALTY INTEREST A. Farmor shall except and reserve in each Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights earned hereunder an overriding royalty-interest equal to twelve and one-half percent of eight eighth's (12.50% of 8/8) of the gross proceeds received from the sale of oil and/or gas produced from wells drilled hereunder without deductions of any kind.

name: 5(A). Notice and Farmor Takeover Right
text: 5. ABANDONMENT OF WELLS (A) In the event any farmout well is completed as non-productive of oil or gas, or as one not capable of producing oil and/or gas in paying quantities or ceases production, Farmee shall immediately give Farmor written notice of the proposed plugging and abandonment. For thirty (30) days after receipt of such written notice, Farmor shall have the right, but not the obligation, to take over the well for the purpose of conducting additional operations as it desires; except that if a drilling rig is on location, notice to plug and abandon may be given by telephone and Farmor's response period shall be limited to forty-eight (48) hours, inclusive of Saturdays, Sundays and legal holidays. In the event Farmor fails to advise Farmee of its election within the prescribed period of time, then Farmor shall be deemed to have elected not to take over such well 6 Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 8 of 18 - Page ID#: 33 • • and such well shall be plugged and abandoned by Farmee in accordance with the terms hereof.

name: 5(B). Unauthorized Abandonment
text: (B) In the event Farmee plugs and abandons any well drilled on Farmout Lands without written notification and Farmor's approval, or fails to give Farmor a reasonable opportunity to consider its options as provided in Section 5(A) hereof, this Agreement, as to the Unearned Farmout Lands, shall forthwith terminate, and Farmee shall have no rights hereunder as to the Unearned Farmout Lands, but Farmee shall, in any case remain responsible for the cost of abandonment including but not limited to restoration and reclamation of the surface acreage affected by the drilling of said well(s).

name: 6. Takeover by Farmor
text: 6. TAKEOVER BY FARMOR If Farmor elects to take over a well under the terms and conditions of Section 5. hereof, the effective date of the takeover shall be the date of approval of Farmor as the successor Operator under the applicable Commonwealth of Kentucky rules and/or regulations or when Farmor takes actual custody of the well, whichever is earlier. As soon as practicable thereafter, Farmor shall reimburse Farmee for the estimated salvage value of Farmee's salvageable equipment in and on the well, less estimated plugging costs. Farmee shall then execute an instrument of assignment conveying to Farmor its interest in said well and associated equipment. Farmee shall also assign to Farmor all of its right, title and interest, in and to, all leasehold, options, farmins, operating agreements, or other support agreements associated with the well and any Operating Rights Earned by Farmor and earned by Farmee pursuant to the terms and conditions hereunder. Farmee shall then have no further rights or obligations under this Agreement in connection with the well being taken over by Farmor, except such rights, obligations and liabilities as accrued before the effective date of the Farmor's succession as Operator.

name: 7(A). Shut-In Royalty
text: 7. SHUT-IN/RENTAL PAYMENTS (A) For any well drilled pursuant to this Agreement, that is located upon or pooled with the Farmout Lands, and, which is capable of production (whether or not such well has already produced), that is shut in for any reasontfor a period of Forty Five (45) days or longer; Farmee shall pay unto Farmor, a Shut-in Royalty of Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00) per well per year, prorated on a monthly � 7 Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 9 of 18 - Page ID#: 34 ♦ • basis. Shut-in Royalties shall be due and payable by the last day of each month any such well is shut-in.

name: 7(B). Advance Shut-In Notice
text: (B) Wheri possible, Farmee shall provide at least ten (10) days advance notice to Farmor of any well being shut-in.

name: 8(A). Operations and Indemnity
text: 8. LIABILITY (A) All operations conducted by Farmee pursuant to the terms hereof shall be at the sole risk and cost and under the exclusive control of Farmee, and Farmee shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Farmor from any and all losses, liabilities, liens, encumbrances, damages, judgments, demands, lawsuits, claims, assessments, charges, fines, penalties or expenses (including but not limited to attorney's fees, or other costs of litigation, liability for environmental harm, damages to natural resources, drainage or mineral trespass, and costs of complying with orders or directives of government entities or agencies) of any kind or character incurred by Farmor and arising out of, in connection with, or resulting from the operations, actions or omissions of Farmee, including but not limited to the reconditioning of wells, injection operations, drilling operations and plugging and abandonment operations, and surface restoration operations on Farmout Lands.

name: 8(B). Liens
text: (B) During the life of this Agreement, the Farmee shall keep the Farmout Lands free and clear from all liens.

name: 9. Warranty of Title
text: 9. WARRANTY OF TITLE Farmor does not warrant title, either express or implied, to any of the Farmout Lands.

name: 10(A). Well Information
text: 10. NOTICES AND WELL INFORMATION (A) Well Information: All well data, information, drilling and well notices to Farmor shall be given as provided in Exhibit "C" hereof. Well data and information shall be held confidential between Farmor and Farmee, for a period of one (1) year after any such well is completed, unless otherwise agreed by the parties hereto in writing.

name: 10(B). General Notices
text: (B) General Notices: All notices, payments or other correspondence provided for in this Farmout Agreement shall be given as follows: 8 Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 10 of 18 - Page ID#: 35 • • Farmor: Equitable Resources Energy Company Two Executive Park Place 1989 East Stone Drive P. 0. Box 1983 Kingsport, TN 37662-1983 ATTN: Lester Zitkus PHONE: 423-224-3800 FAX: 423-224-3891 Farmee: Daugherty Petroleum, Inc. 131 Prosperous Place, Suite 17-A Lexington, KY 40509 ATTN: Mike Wallen PHONE: 606-263-3948 FAX: 606-263-1312

name: 11. Insurance
text: 11. INSURANCE While operations are being conducted hereunder on the Farmout Lands, Farmee agrees to acquire and/or maintain Workers' Compensation, Comprehensive General Public Liability and Automobile Liability Insurance. Farmee further agrees to name Farmor as an additional insured under such insurance policies and further agrees to secure a waiver of subrogation in favor of Farmor under each of the insurance policies noted above. Farmee shall provide Farmor with copies of said Certificates of Insurance.

name: 12. Modifications and Amendments
text: 12. MODIFICATIONS AND AMENDMENTS The interests retained by Farmor in the lands subject to this Agreement, including but not limited to the reserved overriding royalty interest, shall apply to any subsequently acquired interest in such lands, including but not limited to any modifications, or amendments of any leases subject to this Agreement, whether obtained directly or indirectly by Farmee.

name: 13. Term of Farmout Agreement
text: 13. TERM OF FARMOUT AGREEMENT This Farmout Agreement shall be in effect until such time as: (A) This Farmout Agreement terminates pursuant to Sections 3(A)(2), 3(B)(3), 3(F), and/or 5(B) above as a consequence of Farmee's failure to meet the drilling commitments contained herein or Farmee's default; or (B) All Farmout Lands have been earned by Farmee as provided for elsewhere in this Agreement.

name: 14. Audits
text: 14. AUDITS Upon written notice to the Farmee, Farmor may audit Farmee's books and records relating to all payments ( including but not limited to royalty, overriding royalty, payments out of production) associated with any well drilled pursuant to this Agreement. Such audit rights may be exercised by notifying Farmee in writing thirty (30) days prior to commencement of said audit.

name: 15(A). General Compliance
text: 15. GENERAL (A) Farmee shall comply with all obligations, burdens and requirements set forth hereunder or otherwise associated with the lands covered hereby.

name: 15(B). Entry, Surface Damage, and Restoration
text: (B) Farmee shall obtain permission to enter the Farmout Lands from both the surface owner and tenant. Further, Farmee agrees to settle surface damages and to clean up and restore the premises as nearly as possible to its original condition.

name: 15(C). Farmor Access
text: (C) Farmor's employees and authorized representatives, at the sole risk of Farmor, shall have access to the derrick floor of any farmout well at all times.

name: 15(D). Assignment Restrictions
text: (D) This Farmout Agreement may not be assigned, sublet, mortgaged, pledged, encumbered or subjected to a lien or liens by Farmee without the prior written consent of Farmor.

name: 15(E). Annual Report
text: (E) Farmee shall provide Farmor with an Annual Report on January 31 st of each year setting forth the production during the preceding year from each well drilled and completed on the Farmout Lands or on a unit containing Farmout Lands.

name: 16. Right of First Refusal
text: 16. Provided that Farmee drills and completes the test well on or before August 31, 1996, as described in Section 3(A) herein, Farmor grants Farmee a one time Right of First Refusal during the term of this Agreement for a Farmout of the acreage identified on the plat attached hereto and made a part hereof as Exhibit "B-1 ". Upon the completion of the test well and during the term of this Farmout Agreement, Farmor agrees to not grant a farmout of this acreage without first offering to farmout same to Farmee. Farmee shall have fifteen (15) days from receipt of written notification from Farmor to elect to receive a farmout of this acreage. Failure by Farmee to provide Farmor with its election in writing within said fifteen (15) day notice period shall be an indication of Farmee's election not to receive a farmout of this acreage. Should 10 Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 12 of 18 - Page ID#: 37 0 I Farmee elect to receive a farmout of this acreage, Farmor agrees to farmout same, under a separate Farmout Agreement, under the same terms and conditions included in this Farmout Agreement, except that Farmee will be required to drill and complete a minimum of three (3) wells within one year after the date of the farmout, with the first well to be drilled and completed within six (6) months after the date of the Farmout Agreement. Farmee's election to receive a farmout of this acreage shall be accompanied with a payment of $2,000.00. The Right of First Refusal described herein shall automatically terminate upon the expiration or termination of this Farmout Agreement pursuant to Section 13 herein or upon Farmee's election not to receive a farmout of this acreage during the term of this Agreement as described above, or upon Farmee's failure to make an election in writing within the Fifteen (15) day notice period provided above.

name: 17. Successors and Assigns
text: 17. EXECUTION The terms, covenants and conditions hereof shall run in favor of and be binding upon the parties hereto, their successors and assigns, and shall run with said Farmout Lands.

name: 17. Effective Date
text: This Farmout Agreement shall be effective as of the date first above written.

name: Exhibit C(A). Pre-Drilling Requirements
text: A. Pre-Drilling Requirements Operator shall furnish Farmor two copies of the following: 1. Geological Prognosis and Drilling Prognosis 2. Certified Survey Plat of the drillsite location 3. Applications for Federal and State Drilling Permits with attachments 4. Drilling Permit

name: Exhibit C(B)(1). Samples
text: B. Requirements During Drilling Phase 1. Samples: Operator shall collect two complete sets of washed samples at not more than 30 foot intervals from surface to base of surface casinn and 10 feet intervals from base of surface casing to TD. These, along with representative chips from each foot of all cores shall be deposited with a commercial sample service or a State Geological Sample Library with the provision that EREX will have free access thereto. Operator shall employ the service of a qualified wellsite geologist who will thoroughly and timely examine representative samples of each stratigraphic unit and all samples of potential pay zones. Cores Shall be properly and timely analyzed for reservoir capacity and fluid content.

name: Exhibit C(B)(2). Testing
text: 2. Testing: Significant indications of reservoir quality porosity with hydrocarbon shows (from cuttings, mud log and/or E-log) shall be adequately tested in accordance with good oilfield practices.

name: Exhibit C(B)(3)(a). Routine Reports
text: 3. Reports: (a) Routine daily prepaid report of drilling progress Monday through Friday by telephone, telecopy or telegram no later than 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time; said report to be confirmed daily in writing

name: Exhibit C(B)(3)(b). Non-Routine Reports
text: (b) Non-routine occurrences such as notification of significant shows, intent to core, test or log, as well as the results thereof, shall be telephoned to Farmor's designated representative immediately, whether day, night, weekend or holiday.

name: Exhibit C(B)(3)(c). Copies of Reports
text: (c) Two copies of all reports, charts, logs, analyses, surveys and forms pertaining to the subject well shall be provided to Farmor when received by the Operator.

name: Exhibit C(B)(4). Logs
text: 4. Logs: Operator shall run the following well surveys and shall furnish Farmor with two field prints of each survey. Gamma Ray-Caliper Surface to T.D. i Density (FDC) Casing to T.D. _ Neutron (CNL) Casing to T.D. Other Operator shall furnish Farmor a like number of copies of any other surveys run on the subject well.

name: Exhibit C(B)(5). Notification
text: 5. Notification: Timely notice of intent to core, test or log shall be provided so that Farmor's representative may be present to witness same.

name: Exhibit C(C)(1). Post Drilling
text: C. Post Drilling and Completion Phase Reguirements 1. Post Drilling : Operator shall furnish Farmor with one copy of the following (unless otherwise specified): (a) Two final prints of any well survey logs, including directional and temperature surveys THREE COPIES: (b) Geological and drilling reports with core and sample descriptions (c) All drill stem test charts (d) Oil, gas, water and core analysis reports (e) Any other data pertinent to the drilling, testing and surveying of the well

name: Exhibit C(C)(2). Completion Phase
text: 2. Completion Phase : If the well is completed as a producer, Operator shall furnish Farmor full information on the completion progress, including one copy of the data listed below: (a) All cased hole logs (b) Detailed daily completion report including perforations, treatments, production and the results of back pressure and productivity tests (c) Oil, gas and water analyses (d) All reports required by governmental agencies (e) Weekly recap of daily production information for sixty (60) days following completion

name: Exhibit C(D)(1). Delivery of Data
text: D. General 1. All reports, analyses, surveys, forms and other similar data shall be delivered to: Equitable Resources Energy Company 1989 E. Stone Drive Post Office Box 1983 Kingsport, TN 37662-1983 Attn: Mike Stamper

name: Exhibit D. Assignment of Operating Rights
text: WITNESSETH: That for and in consideration of the sum of Ten Dollars ($10.00), and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, said Assignor does hereby transfer, sell, assign and set over unto the said Assignee, the right to operate, maintain and rework Well No. , and the right to produce oil and/or gas from Well No. and from lands lying within a acre circle surrounding said Well No. , with said Well No. being at the center of said acre circle, which well location and lands encompassing said acre circle are highlighted and identified on Exhibit "A" attached hereto and made a part hereof.

name: Exhibit D. Term of Assignment
text: It is agreed between the parties hereto that this Assignment of Operating Rights shall remain in force and effect so long as oil and gas or either of them is produced in paying quantities from Well No. or said Well No. is shut-in pursuant to the terms and conditions of that certain unrecorded Farmout Agreement by and between the parties hereto dated , 1996.

name: Exhibit D. Disclaimer and Indemnity
text: This Agreement and Assignment is made without any warranty whatsoever, and Assignor hereby disclaims any and all warranties whether express, statutory, or implied as to title, description, physical condition, (including, without limitation, the environmental condition of the surface and subsurface of the lands associated with Well No. ) quality, value, fitness for a particular purpose, merchantability, or otherwise. Assignee acknowledges that Assignor has made no statements, representations or guarantees concerning the mechanical condition and fitness of Well or as to the reserves which may be produced and/or the productive capacity of said Well. The Assignee agrees to indemnify, save, and hold harmless Assignor against all lawsuits, damages, claims, demands, suits, cost, expenses, liabilities, and causes of action, of every kind and character, including attorney's fees, incident to, or arising directly or indirectly from, operations by Assignee on the premises herein assigned.

name: Exhibit D. Appurtenant Rights
text: The Assignor, for the consideration aforesaid, assigns to the Assignee any and all rights and privileges possessed by it, under the deeds or leases by which Assignor received its title, which are necessary or convenient for the operation, maintenance, reworking and production of oil and gas from the well drilled thereon, including rights of way or easements for such purposes, which rights and privileges are expressly subject to the terms and conditions of the subject deeds or leases by which Assignor received its title.

name: Exhibit D. Reserved Overriding Royalty
text: As part of the consideration for this Assignment, the Assignor expressly reserves and excepts an overriding royalty interest equal to ( % of 8/8) of the gross proceeds received by Assignee from the sale of produced from the herein assigned premises, without deductions of any kind, except that Assignor shall bear its proportionate part of any severance tax. It is agreed and understood that said overriding royalty interest shall be paid monthly to Assignor, on or before the 28th day of each and every month. Assignee shall furnish to Assignor, at the time of monthly payment a statement showing the amount of gas and/or oil produced, transported and sold during the preceding month for each well drilled and the proceeds received therefrom. In the event Assignee fails to pay any overriding royalty interest to Assignor when due, the Assignor shall have a lien on all future production and proceeds received on any well for which overriding royalty was not paid.

name: Exhibit D. Reservation of Title
text: It is expressly understood and agreed that the Assignor, by this instrument, expressly reserves and excepts title to the aforementioned lands, and all rights connected thereto, and grants, conveys and assigns other such rights to Assignee only to the extent set forth herein.

name: Exhibit D. Assignment Restrictions
text: Prior to the Assignment of any interest or rights in and to Well No. , Assignee shall give Assignor written notification of its intent to assign. In no event shall Assignee make any Assignment of the rights obtained hereunder which would cause its rights and interest in and to Well No. to be less than a twenty-five percent (25%) working interest, nor shall Assignee assign its rights as operator of Well No. , or in any other manner assign its rights, duties or obligations as operator of Well No. , without the prior written consent of Assignor.

name: Exhibit D. Formation Reservation
text: There is expressly reserved and excepted from this assignment all of the oil and gas, and all rights associated therewith, to all strata and formations extending below the formation.

name: Exhibit D. Successors and Assigns
text: This Agreement and Assignment, and the terms, conditions, covenants and provisions hereof, shall be binding upon and shall inure to the benefit of the Assignor and the Assignee, and their respective successors and assigns.

name: Exhibit D. Subject to Farmout Agreement
text: This Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights is made pursuant to and subject to the terms and conditions of that certain unrecorded Farmout Agreement by and between Assignor and Assignee dated , 1996.
